checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-CLIENT-SUBMIT-REQUEST: eth_sendRawTransactionSync Input Validation
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Locate the eth_sendRawTransactionSync RPC handler. 2. Submit malformed raw transaction data (non-hex, truncated RLP, invalid signature) and verify rejection with appropriate error codes. 3. Verify timeout parameter is bounded by node-configured maximum. 4. Submit a request with timeout exceeding the maximum and verify it is capped or rejected. 5. Verify concurrent synchronous connections do not block consensus operations.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP7966-PRECOND-002. Boundary edge EDGE-CLIENT-SUBMIT-REQUEST from EXT-USER-VIA-JSON-RPC. Trust model: full TX validation, bounded timeout, no consensus blocking.

checklist.title: Verify transaction data validation rejects all invalid RLP-encoded transactions at boundary
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Submit transactions with invalid RLP encoding and verify rejection. 2. Submit transactions with valid RLP but invalid signature (wrong v value, s > secp256k1n/2). 3. Submit transactions with nonce=0 for non-empty accounts and check handling.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP7966-PRECOND-002, node ACTION-VALIDATE-TX-DATA. Supporting boundary check.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-START-LENGTH-CHECK: BLAKE2F Precompile Input Validation
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Locate the BLAKE2F precompile (address 0x09) input handler. 2. Verify input must be exactly 213 bytes; submit 212 and 214 bytes and confirm rejection. 3. Verify final flag byte must be 0 or 1; submit flag=2 and confirm InvalidParameter. 4. Verify gas cost = rounds * GAS_BLAKE2_PER_ROUND; submit rounds=0 and rounds=2^32-1 to test bounds. 5. Verify high round count charges appropriately to prevent resource exhaustion.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-BLAKE2F-PRECOND-003. Boundary edge EDGE-START-LENGTH-CHECK from EXT-CONTRACT-CALLER-PRECOMPILE. Trust model: exactly 213 bytes, flag 0/1, gas=rounds*per_round.

checklist.title: Verify BLAKE2F parameter parsing after length validation is correct
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Verify the 213-byte input is parsed correctly: rounds(4)+h(64)+m(128)+t(16)+f(1). 2. Submit valid 213-byte input with known test vectors and verify output matches.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-BLAKE2F-PRECOND-003, node STATE-INPUT-LENGTH-VALID. Supporting boundary check.

checklist.title: Falsify node unready state invariant: verify all required unready conditions are checked
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Identify the 'node unready' check in the RPC layer. 2. Verify it includes at minimum: syncing, no peers, chain not initialized. 3. Attempt to falsify: find a state where the node is functionally unready but passes the check.

checklist.title: Falsify receipt response post-condition: verify all required fields in RPC response
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Locate the receipt formatting in eth_sendRawTransactionSync response. 2. Verify response contains: transaction hash, block hash, block number, gas used, status, logs. 3. Attempt to falsify: find a code path where receipt is returned with missing fields.

checklist.title: Falsify TX validation pre-condition: submit invalid transaction data and verify error return
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Submit tx with invalid nonce, insufficient balance, and gas limit exceeding block gas limit. 2. Verify each returns an appropriate error code, not a generic failure.

checklist.title: Falsify error formatting post-condition: verify error codes are correct and no internal info leaked
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Trigger various error conditions in the RPC handler. 2. Verify error codes follow JSON-RPC spec. 3. Verify no internal stack traces or implementation details are exposed in error messages.

checklist.title: Falsify BLAKE2F gas cost invariant: verify GAS_BLAKE2_PER_ROUND reflects actual computation cost
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Benchmark actual BLAKE2F computation time per round across implementations. 2. Compare with GAS_BLAKE2_PER_ROUND (1 gas per round). 3. Attempt to falsify: find implementations where computation per round is disproportionately expensive.

checklist.title: Falsify BLAKE2F parameter parsing post-condition: verify correct parsing after length validation passes
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Submit 213-byte input and verify rounds, h, m, t, f are extracted at correct byte offsets. 2. Verify flag check is performed after parsing (flag must be 0 or 1).

checklist.title: Falsify BLAKE2F gas computation post-condition: verify gas equals extracted rounds * per-round cost
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Submit BLAKE2F calls with rounds=1,10,100 and verify gas charged matches rounds * GAS_BLAKE2_PER_ROUND. 2. Verify rounds=0 charges 0 gas and still returns valid output.

checklist.title: Falsify versioned hash matching pre-condition: verify blob commitment hashes match execution payload
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Locate versioned hash validation in blob sidecar processing. 2. Verify hashes derived from blob commitments match those in execution payload. 3. Craft a blob sidecar with mismatched versioned hashes and verify rejection.

checklist.title: Falsify KZG trusted setup invariant: verify commitment verification depends on valid ceremony parameters
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Locate the KZG trusted setup loading in the codebase. 2. Verify the setup parameters are loaded from a known, trusted source. 3. Verify the commitment verification would fail with tampered setup parameters.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-DENEB-BC-INV-004. Invariant on ACTION-VALIDATE-VERSIONED-HASHES. Assumes trusted setup was performed correctly.

checklist.title: Falsify attestation inclusion window post-condition: verify out-of-window attestations are rejected
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Locate attestation inclusion window validation. 2. Submit attestation with slot < current_slot - SLOTS_PER_EPOCH and verify rejection. 3. Verify the window boundary is exactly SLOTS_PER_EPOCH.

checklist.title: Falsify exit signature validation post-condition: verify invalid exit signatures are rejected
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Locate voluntary exit signature verification. 2. Submit exit with invalid BLS signature and verify rejection. 3. Submit exit with valid signature but wrong validator index and verify rejection.

checklist.title: Falsify contested claim invariant: verify on-chain data limitations are documented and mitigated
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Review claim dispute resolution logic. 2. Verify that contested claims require off-chain evidence (e.g., broadcast file). 3. Attempt to falsify: find a path where a contested claim is resolved using only on-chain data.

checklist.title: Falsify broadcast file verification invariant: verify community repository entries are verified correctly
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Locate broadcast file loading and verification logic. 2. Verify entries are cryptographically verified (signatures, hashes). 3. Attempt to falsify: submit a tampered broadcast file and verify rejection.

checklist.title: Falsify claim submission post-condition: verify claim is stored and verification begins
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Submit a valid claim and verify it is persisted in storage. 2. Verify that verification process is triggered after submission. 3. Attempt to falsify: submit claim and check if it can be lost before verification completes.

checklist.title: Falsify validator active check pre-condition: verify inactive validators are rejected
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Locate validator active status check. 2. Submit claim from an inactive/exited validator and verify rejection. 3. Verify the check uses the correct epoch for status determination.

checklist.title: Falsify precompile address validation pre-condition: verify post-Istanbul precompile set is correct
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Locate the precompile address validation for Istanbul fork. 2. Verify the address range includes all Istanbul precompiles (1-9). 3. Attempt to call address 10 as precompile post-Istanbul and verify it is treated as regular contract.

checklist.title: Falsify DAO fork post-condition: verify all 117 DAO accounts are zeroed and ether moved to refund contract
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Locate apply_dao() function. 2. Verify all 117 DAO_ACCOUNTS are iterated and their balances set to zero. 3. Verify the DAO_REFUND_CONTRACT receives the sum of all balances. 4. Attempt to falsify: verify no account is skipped due to off-by-one or list truncation.

checklist.title: Falsify fork window check post-condition: verify header triggers correct fork window behavior
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Locate fork window check for DAO fork. 2. Verify headers within the fork window trigger the DAO fork logic. 3. Verify headers outside the window do not trigger the logic.

checklist.title: Falsify DAO account list completeness invariant: verify list contains exactly 117 accounts
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Locate the DAO_ACCOUNTS list constant. 2. Count entries and verify exactly 117. 3. Cross-reference with known DAO hack affected accounts.

checklist.title: Falsify trustee management security invariant: verify withdrawal access control
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Locate trustee withdrawal logic. 2. Verify only authorized trustees can initiate withdrawals. 3. Attempt to falsify: call withdrawal from non-trustee address and verify rejection.

checklist.title: Falsify Fp field encoding pre-condition: verify top 16 bytes zeroed and value < field modulus
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Locate BLS12-381 Fp field element validation. 2. Submit element with non-zero top 16 bytes and verify rejection. 3. Submit element with value >= field modulus and verify rejection.

checklist.title: Falsify G1ADD/G2ADD no-subgroup-check invariant: verify operations work on any curve point
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Verify G1ADD and G2ADD do not perform subgroup checks. 2. Submit points not on the correct subgroup and verify operations succeed. 3. Document the application-layer risk of using results without subgroup verification.

checklist.title: Falsify subgroup check invariant: verify subgroup checks prevent invalid point attacks in MSM/pairing
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Locate subgroup check in MSM and pairing operations. 2. Verify points are checked for subgroup membership before pairing. 3. Attempt to falsify: submit a point not in the subgroup to a pairing operation and verify rejection.

checklist.title: Falsify MSM gas discount post-condition: verify discount table is applied correctly based on pair count
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Locate the MSM gas discount table. 2. Verify gas cost for k pairs matches: k * per_pair_cost * discount[k] / multiplier. 3. Test with k=1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128 and verify correct discount application.

checklist.title: Falsify field encoding validation post-condition: verify invalid encoding causes operation failure
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Submit BLS12-381 operation with invalid field encoding. 2. Verify the operation returns an error/empty output (not a corrupted result). 3. Verify gas is still charged for the failed operation.

checklist.title: Falsify BLS gas pipeline post-condition: verify operation identification leads to correct gas calculation
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Trace the gas calculation pipeline: identify operation -> fixed/variable -> compute. 2. Verify each BLS operation (G1ADD, G2ADD, MSM, pairing, map) maps to correct gas formula. 3. Attempt to falsify: find an operation that gets misidentified leading to wrong gas.

checklist.title: Falsify SELFDESTRUCT new account penalty pre-condition: verify additional gas charge for non-existent beneficiary
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Locate SELFDESTRUCT gas calculation. 2. Verify that when beneficiary does not exist, CREATE_GAS (25000) is added. 3. Execute SELFDESTRUCT to non-existent address and verify the additional charge.

checklist.title: Falsify SELFDESTRUCT post-condition: verify code/storage deletion and balance transfer to beneficiary
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Execute SELFDESTRUCT and verify contract code is removed. 2. Verify all storage slots are cleared. 3. Verify full balance is transferred to beneficiary. 4. Attempt to falsify: check if any storage artifacts remain post-SELFDESTRUCT.

checklist.title: Falsify child call gas check post-condition: verify insufficient gas causes OOG in child context
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Locate the 63/64 gas rule for child calls (EIP-150). 2. Verify that child call receives at most 63/64 of remaining gas. 3. Verify insufficient gas in child context triggers OOG without consuming all parent gas.

checklist.title: Falsify rollback-none conflict pre-condition: verify atomicity=none + onFailure=rollback is rejected
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Locate batch request validation for EIP-7867. 2. Submit a batch with atomicity=none and onFailure=rollback. 3. Verify the request is rejected with an appropriate error.

checklist.title: Falsify batch timeout invariant: verify DApps must encode deadlines in smart contract logic
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Review batch processing for timeout handling. 2. Verify the RPC layer does not enforce timeouts (deferred to smart contract layer). 3. Document the risk: batches without contract-level deadlines could hang indefinitely.

checklist.title: Falsify atomicity parsing post-condition: verify correct mode determination (strict/loose/none)
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Submit batch requests with atomicity=strict, loose, and none. 2. Verify each is parsed correctly and the correct execution mode is applied. 3. Submit invalid atomicity value and verify error.
